examples.title: hybrid008 - collatz
examples.description:
Collatz Fractal works best modifying a Mandelbox or Menger Sponge type
fractal. Here it is used briefly halfway through the iteration loop.
Add_global_C_constant has been unchecked for the Mandelbox and only used
for the short duration of the Collatz fractal. Uncheck
add_global_C_constant, then uncheck the slot2-Collatz
and you will see the subtle differences this tweak makes.

voxel export with Bristorbrot4D
examples.description:
This setting illustrates the use of the voxel layer export

  1. Hit Render button and checkout rendered image of the Bristorbrot4D.
  2. Go to File > Export Voxel Layers, a popup dialog with settings appears.
  3. Click on Render Layers, this will render the stack of layers to use for 3d reconstruction. See also more info inside this dialog.
